selected.rationale: The Sustainability Buyer focuses heavily on environmental footprints and supply chain transparency, which directly matches the advertiser's core value of sustainability and use of recycled ocean plastic.

The Fitness Enthusiast looks for performance apparel and technical fabrics, perfectly aligning with the advertiser's primary product category of activewear positioned between Lululemon and Girlfriend Collective.
The Wellness Optimizer has a low price sensitivity and typical AOV of $95, matching the premium price tier and estimated $100 AOV of this sustainable activewear brand.

rejected.reason: The Busy Parent prioritizes family-friendly items, kid products, and convenience, which does not align with a women's premium DTC activewear brand.
The Gen Z Aesthete has a typical AOV of $48, which is far too low for a brand positioned in the premium tier between Lululemon and Girlfriend Collective with an estimated $100 AOV.
The Pet Parent focuses strictly on pet food, supplies, and health, making them entirely irrelevant to an apparel and activewear advertiser.
The Affluent Classic targets an older demographic of 50-68 with classic apparel and heritage messaging, whereas the advertiser targets ages 22-45 with modern sustainable activewear.
The Convenience-First Millennial focuses on instant delivery, meal kits, and immediate subscription services rather than standalone apparel purchases.
The Value-Conscious Shopper has high price sensitivity and looks for discount-forward messaging and bundles, which contradicts the brand's premium tier positioning.
The Gifter is explicitly disinterested in self-care-only framing and relies on short-term gifting holidays, whereas this advertiser is a direct-to-consumer one-off activewear brand.
